# NINJA CPA Review

> NINJA CPA Review provides comprehensive CPA exam preparation through structured study frameworks, video lectures, audio notes, and interactive learning tools.

NINJA CPA Review is a leading CPA exam prep platform offering the N.I.N.J.A Study Framework and multiple learning modalities including NINJA Blitz Videos, NINJA Audio, flashcards, and the dojo practice environment. The platform covers all four CPA exam sections: AUD, BEC, FAR, and BAR.

## Key Topics

- CPA Exam
- N.I.N.J.A Study Framework
- NINJA Blitz Videos
- NINJA Audio
- AUD (Audit)
- BEC (Business Environment & Concepts)
- FAR (Financial Accounting & Reporting)
- BAR (Business Analysis & Reporting)
- Study Materials
- Test Prep
- Flashcards
- Audio Notes
- Dojo Practice
- Subscription
